summary.name: Beyond Compare
summary.one_liner: Beyond Compare is a file and folder comparison, merge, and synchronization application from Scooter Software for Windows, macOS, and Linux.
use_cases: Comparing two versions of source code files
Merging changes from two file versions
Synchronizing a laptop or backing up a computer
Scheduling automated folder syncs from the command line
Comparing folders, zip archives, or cloud storage contents
summary.what_it_does: Beyond Compare compares files and folders with filters that limit the view to the differences the user cares about. It integrates FTP sites, cloud storage, and zip files, and provides dedicated viewers for text, data files, executables, binary data, and images. Its merge view combines changes from two versions into one output, with conflict review and a built-in syntax-highlighting editor. Folder Sync reconciles differences between locations, including disks, FTP servers, and zip files. Tasks can be automated with a scripting language and run from the command line for scheduled syncs.
notable: Folder Sync with filters for backups and website updates
Dedicated viewers for images, binaries, and data files
Integrated use from most version control systems
Scriptable and callable from the command line for scheduled syncs
caveats: Pricing is not stated on the page; the awesome-mac listing marks it as freeware, which the page itself does not confirm
